assertions.name: monodromy_trace_yields_sqrt5
assertions.source: Picard-Lefschetz integral evaluated over the 5 branch points

description: Evaluates the open Picard-Lefschetz monodromy of the H₂S chiral residue over the embedded hyperelliptic quintic 𝒳₅: y² = x⁵ − 1. The contour integral around the 5 singular branch points analytically inherits the quadratic Gauss sum, bounding the monodromy normalisation to exactly √5. Projecting this onto the archimedean phase yields the Bring scaling factor 1/√5. Applied to the size-scaled (n=3) sp³ geometric opening, this definitively returns the +2.17° H₂S residual phase angle, completely closing the conj:h2s-angle-s3-braid-holonomy monodromy compute.
